Lawyer for Accused in Ketan Agarwal Murder Case Opposes Custody Extension

The lawyer for Siya Goyal, an accused in the Ketan Agarwal murder case, has raised questions regarding the investigation. The lawyer stated that they will oppose the police's request to extend the custody of the accused, claiming there is no direct evidence against her. The case involves the murder of Ketan Agarwal.
